includes: // ARCHIVE is parked reference source (card 0121). It is deliberately
// outside the workspaces and is not maintained, so linting it only
// produces noise about code nobody is editing.
// SVGs here are design assets (the app icon and the logo), not markup we
// author. a11y rules want a <title> in them, which would mean editing the
// Emscripten glue shipped beside its .wasm — vendored build output that
// happens to live under static/, not source anyone edits here.
// The Rust voice protocol generator owns both TypeScript copies and tests
// them byte-for-byte. Its ts-rs output is valid but not Biome-formatted.
// Drizzle owns migration snapshots. Formatting them creates large semantic-free diffs.
// The brand stylesheets are GENERATED from the aven-ceo brand definition by
// `bun run brand:generate`. Their shape comes from that definition and the
// generator's rules, so a stylistic complaint about one is a complaint about
// the generator — and fixing it in the output would survive exactly until the
// next run. aven-brands ignores the same three files for the same reason.
